title: Terms of service
translation_note: This translation is for your convenience. If it differs from the English version, the English version prevails.
intro: By using Vendora, you agree to these terms. If you don't, please don't use the platform.

eligibility.title: 1. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a binding contract in your jurisdiction. Vendors must be a legitimate business — sole proprietors, LLCs, corporations.

account.title: 2. Your account
account.body: Keep your account details accurate. You're responsible for keeping your password safe and for any activity under your account. Tell us immediately at <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email> if you suspect unauthorized access.

role.title: 3. Vendora's role
items: Vendora is a marketplace that helps hosts find and contact event vendors. We don't provide the event services listed on Vendora.
Vendors are independent businesses. They aren't Vendora's employees, agents, partners or joint venturers, and Vendora is not a party to any agreement between a host and a vendor.
Each vendor sets its own services, prices, availability and policies, and is responsible for how it performs them.

We review vendor applications before a listing goes live. Unless we expressly say we've verified something, we don't verify or guarantee any vendor's quality, availability, suitability, credentials, licenses, insurance, safety or performance.

hosts.title: 4. For hosts
hosts.body: Browsing Vendora and sending inquiries is free for hosts. When you book a vendor, you contract directly with that vendor — Vendora is the introduction layer, not the contracting party. Payment terms, deposits, cancellation policies and deliverables are between you and the vendor.

vendors.title: 5. For vendors
items: Listing on Vendora is free, and Vendora takes no commission on your bookings: hosts pay you directly.
Pro and Premium are optional monthly plans (see Subscriptions below). You can pause a listing whenever you need to.
Your profile, portfolio and reviews are your data. If you'd like a copy, email us and we'll send it to you.
We do not accept money to influence search ranking. Sort order is determined by fit and quality signals only.
Keep your profile, prices, photos and quotes accurate and up to date.
You're responsible for the licenses, permits, insurance and other legal requirements that apply to your business and services.
You're responsible for delivering the services you describe and for honoring the prices, policies and promises you make to hosts.

subscriptions.title: 6. Subscriptions
items: The Free plan costs nothing. Pro and Premium are billed monthly through Stripe and renew automatically each month until you cancel.

You can cancel any time from the Subscription page. Canceling stops your plan from renewing: you keep paid access until the end of the current billing period, aren't charged again, and your account stays open on the Free plan.

Deleting your account is different: any active plan is canceled immediately, your access ends when the account is deleted, you won't be charged again, and there's no refund for the unused part of the current billing period (see section 15).
You can switch between Pro and Premium from the Subscription page. Before you confirm, the page shows what you'll be charged and when your new billing month starts.
If we change a plan's price, we'll tell you before the new price applies to your plan.

transactions.title: 7. Transactions, cancellations & disputes
items: Hosts and vendors agree on prices, deposits, payment, cancellations, refunds and deliverables between themselves.

Disputes about a vendor's services, deposits, refunds, cancellations, deliverables or how an event went are between the host and the vendor, unless Vendora expressly says otherwise. If something goes wrong, contact the other party first. If you think someone on Vendora is acting fraudulently, tell us at <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email>.
Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under consumer protection or other laws that can't be waived by agreement.

content.title: 8. Content & intellectual property
items: You keep ownership of what you upload: photos, videos, profile text, messages and reviews. By posting it, you confirm you own it or have the rights needed to post it.

You give Vendora a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to host, store, copy and display that content only as needed to run Vendora and to show and promote your listing within Vendora's own features, such as search, Explore, category and city pages, and links people share from Vendora.
Vendora's name, logo, design and software belong to Vendora. Please don't copy or use them without permission.

If you believe something on Vendora infringes your copyright or other rights, email <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email> with a link to the content, what you own, and how to reach you. We'll review it and may remove the content.

reviews.title: 9. Reviews
items: Reviews are the opinions of the people who write them, not Vendora's. They must be honest and based on a real experience.
A host can review a vendor only after the vendor has marked their inquiry as booked. We don't check what a review says or guarantee that it's accurate.
We may remove or hide reviews that are fake, abusive, irrelevant, unlawful or against these terms.

ai.title: 10. AI-assisted features
items: Vendora doesn't currently use AI to write or send messages on anyone's behalf. Some older messages are labeled as sent automatically or by AI; they came from an earlier feature that has been retired.
Vendors can turn on an automatic first reply to new inquiries. The vendor writes that reply; it isn't written by AI.
Vendors are responsible for every message sent from their account, including automatic replies. If we add AI features, we'll update this section.

conduct.title: 11. Prohibited conduct
items: scrape, copy or harvest data from Vendora, including vendor listings
post fake or misleading reviews, or manipulate reviews or search ranking
send fake, fraudulent or spam inquiries or messages
harass, threaten or abuse other users
commit fraud or impersonate another person or business
upload malware, or try to get around Vendora's security or access limits
infringe anyone's intellectual property or other rights
use Vendora for anything illegal, or interfere with how it runs

disclaimers.title: 12. Disclaimers
disclaimers.body: To the extent the law allows, Vendora is provided "as is" and "as available." Vendors are independent businesses, and we don't guarantee any vendor's availability, quality or performance. We also don't guarantee that you'll get bookings or business results, or that Vendora will always be available or free of errors.

liability.title: 13. Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Vendora's liability is limited to fees you've paid us in the 12 months prior to a claim. We're not liable for indirect, consequential, or punitive damages.

indemnification.title: 14. Indemnification
indemnification.body: To the extent the law allows, you agree to cover Vendora's losses and reasonable costs, including legal fees, from claims by others that arise from your services, the content you upload, your breach of these terms, or your violation of someone else's rights.

termination.title: 15. Termination
items: You can delete your account anytime from your settings. Deleting it ends your access immediately and cancels any active paid plan at the same moment, so you won't be charged again. There's no refund for the unused part of the current billing period. To stop paying but keep your account, cancel your plan instead (see section 6).

We can suspend or close an account, or hide a listing, with notice (or without notice for severe violations) if it violates these terms, is involved in fraud or unlawful activity, or puts other users' safety or Vendora's security at risk.
Sections 7, 9, 12, 13, 14 and 16 continue to apply after an account is closed.

law.title: 16. Governing law & disputes
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of North Carolina, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Disputes are resolved in the state or federal courts located in North Carolina.

changes.title: 17. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms; meaningful changes will be announced via email and a banner notice 30 days before they take effect. The date at the top shows when they last changed.
